criteria.statement: The root is one Git repository
The original AppleBooks history remains reachable and its imported tree is unchanged
criteria.evidence_command: NESTED_HEAD=$(python3 -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("agent-system/work/P0/evidence/preflight.json"))["nested_head"])') && git merge-base --is-ancestor "$NESTED_HEAD" HEAD && test "$(git rev-parse "$NESTED_HEAD^{tree}")" = "$(git rev-parse HEAD:AppleBooks)"

criteria.statement: No nested Git repository remains active
Every valid example validates and every static must-fail fixture is rejected
criteria.evidence_command: for f in agent-system/examples/valid/*.json; do python3 -m agentctl validate "$f" >/dev/null || exit 1; done; for f in agent-system/examples/invalid/static/*.json; do if python3 -m agentctl validate "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 1; fi; done

criteria.statement: A dependency DAG can expose several tasks as ready simultaneously
criteria.evidence_command: python3 -c "import json; e=json.load(open('agent-system/work/DRY-RUN/evidence/events.json'))['events']; assert any(x.get('reason_code')=='multiple_ready_tasks' for x in e)"

criteria.statement: Lease fencing and path-lock conflicts are rejected for their specific reasons
criteria.evidence_command: python3 -c "import json; c={x.get('reason_code') for x in json.load(open('agent-system/work/DRY-RUN/evidence/events.json'))['events']}; assert {'path_lock_conflict','stale_fencing_token'} <= c"

criteria.statement: Semantic-lock conflicts are rejected independently of path locks
criteria.evidence_command: python3 -c "import json; c={x.get('reason_code') for x in json.load(open('agent-system/work/DRY-RUN/evidence/events.json'))['events']}; assert 'semantic_lock_conflict' in c"

criteria.statement: A self-review claim is rejected by recorded identity comparison
criteria.evidence_command: python3 -c "import json; c={x.get('reason_code') for x in json.load(open('agent-system/work/DRY-RUN/evidence/events.json'))['events']}; assert 'self_review_rejected' in c"

criteria.statement: Context hashes invalidate stale consumers and permit an explicit rebuild
criteria.evidence_command: python3 -c "import json; c={x.get('reason_code') for x in json.load(open('agent-system/work/DRY-RUN/evidence/events.json'))['events']}; assert {'context_stale','context_rebuilt'} <= c"

criteria.statement: The human-readable and machine-readable document authority orders agree byte-for-byte
Documentation checks pass from a clean checkout
An independent architectural authority completed the G0 architecture audit with no blocking findings
The human approves the active product scope and its explicitly deferred programs
The human approves the authority map and authorizes evaluation against this immutable G0 criteria set
